why: Both analyses land on the key's hedgehog (combination food-and-drug superstores, #1 or #2 in each market, profit per local household), the same stop-doing decisions and the same brutal facts; Analysis 1 is slightly cleaner on calibration, since Analysis 2 misreads Rival A as more than twice Lindqvist's size and adds assumed numeric targets. Analysis 2 is the better hand-off because its verdict is more actionable, it commits to rebuilding nearly the whole store base as combination stores, and it folds the family centers into that format rather than freezing them for sale.
